# NEW S65a pedestal-synchronized pulse-shape timing under pile-up and gain sag

Academic-grade study: compare a constant-fraction discriminator with template cross-correlation and analytic time-walk correction against ridge regression, gradient-boosted trees, MLP waveform regressors, 1D-CNN encoders, and a compact transformer where sequence length supports attention.

Quantify pulse-shape, leading-edge timing, pedestal-memory, pile-up spacing, and saturation/gain-sag effects using run-blocked splits, leakage checks, and bootstrap confidence intervals on timing bias, sigma68, tail risk, and energy/PID-conditioned residuals.
